title: US and allied Governments’ Recommendations: Securing Network Devices Against Russian APT Groups

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: LegacyHive PoC exposes a Windows Privilege Escalation flaw affecting fully patched Windows desktop and server systems. Just hours after Microsoft’s July 2026 Patch Tuesday, security researcher Nightmare Eclipse, also known as Chaotic Eclipse, published a new Windows zero-day proof-of-concept called LegacyHive. This time, the target is the Windows User Profile Service (ProfSvc), and unlike the […]
title: Chaotic Eclipse Unveils LegacyHive Exploit Affecting Fully Patched Windows Systems

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: AsyncAPI npm packages with 2M weekly downloads were compromised, spreading malware with info-stealing, crypto-theft and RAT capabilities. OX Security researchers disclosed on July 14 that the AsyncAPI npm organization was compromised, with malicious code injected into four packages that together account for over 2 million weekly downloads. The affected versions are @asyncapi/generator 3.3.1, @asyncapi/generator-components 0.7.1, […]
title: AsyncAPI npm Supply Chain Attack: Malware Injected Into Packages With 2 Million Weekly Downloads
